mapper.insert: INSERT INTO cart (user_id, sku_id, product_id, quantity, selected) VALUES (#{userId}, #{skuId}, #{productId}, #{quantity}, #{selected})
mapper.update: UPDATE cart SET quantity = #{quantity} WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE cart SET selected = #{selected} WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE cart SET selected = #{selected} WHERE user_id = #{userId}
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM cart WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY create_time DESC
SELECT * FROM cart WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND sku_id = #{skuId}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM cart WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND id IN #{id}
